AttachStmt.doc: Parsed ATTACH statement. db_expr is the filename / URI expression (Expr); schema_name is the OWNED logical alias under which the new database is bound; key_expr is an optional encryption-key expression (v1: parsed but the executor raises EncryptionNotSupported when present and non-empty at runtime).

AttachParseOk.doc: Successful parse: the ATTACH AST plus the index of the next unread token (typically the statement terminator or Eof).

parse_attach.doc: Parse an ATTACH statement starting at tokens[start]. Consumes the ATTACH keyword, optional DATABASE keyword, the db expression via parse_expr, the AS keyword, the schema-name identifier (rejecting reserved 'main' and 'temp' case-insensitively), and an optional KEY expression. Stops BEFORE the statement terminator. Returns ParseError on any malformed prefix; expression errors propagate as-is from parse_expr.
